done_when: An FDE can follow the guides to the first Promote without finding a contradictory rule, a promise of an unbuilt feature, a placeholder address or a missing production step.

known.title: Gate: update the shipped coordinator or worker instructions

findings.body:
Raise: Gate.
Case: normal use - an FDE initializes or upgrades a client repo and follows its agent through sign-off and production preparation.
The change adds production preparation and a client-hosted deployment path, but updates neither `src/forge/templates/skill.md` nor `src/forge/templates/brief.md`, as the supplied repository review rule requires for changed coordinator or worker steps. The shipped coordinator journey also still promises choosing Build now or Later at sign-off, whereas the changed README labels that command unavailable. `story.ships` distributes that unchanged journey to both hosts. Update the shipped instructions to carry the corrected sign-off guidance and production flow so the agent gives the FDE the same route as these guides.
findings.title: Gate: update the shipped coordinator or worker instructions

stop.reason: Owner chose one more round: add the new steps to the shipped guide and brief

why: A first-time FDE gets stuck because the guides say Claude runs the sign-off review, but the canvas check in that same sign-off always runs on Codex. They give three different plan-read rules, promise a sign-off step that is only a plan so far, show a platform address placeholder, and have no production checklist, role definitions or path for a client's cloud or servers.
